body:
Meet the Letter Buddies: 1. sh 2. ch 3. th 4. any /sh/ word, such as shoe, shell, sheep.
Digraph Picture Sort: any sh picture (ship, shell, shoe, sheep, shark) and any ch picture (chick, cheese, chair, chin, cherry).
Fix the Word: 1. ship 2. chick 3. thumbs 4. whale 5. sock.
Letter Buddy Check: 1. shed 2. chop 3. then 4. duck 5. whip, read with /wh/ (or /w/, which is accepted).
Scoring tip: on "I spelled the word", a correct buddy with one wrong vowel is Getting there.
title: Answer key: Two Letters, One Sound
